title: New Process Recycles Nuclear Waste into Valuable Isotopes
summary: A new technique is being developed to recover reusable fuel and high-value isotopes from stored nuclear waste.

title: Mushroom-Based Vegan Leather Reaches Production Scale

title: Gravitational Wave Detectors Exploring Quantum Mechanics
summary: A NASA NIAC-funded team is developing a quantum-based concept to detect gravitational waves without physical laser links between spacecraft.
